cases.name: 1. round trip (versioned payload, fence, sealed completion)
cases.details: Job enqueued with versioned envelope {version:2, businessKey:'welcome:p-1', payload}; claimed with worker lease and monotonic fence token; completed with state='sent' and payload sealed to NULL.

cases.name: 2. transactional producer
cases.details: Enqueue within outer business transaction; aborted transaction rolls back job row completely; committed transaction persists durable queued job.

cases.name: 3. crash during I/O: lease expiry then recovery
cases.details: Worker A dies holding lease; worker B cannot claim before lease expiry; after clock advances past lease_until, worker B claims the job with incremented attempt count (2) and monotonic fence (2).

cases.name: 4. stale worker rejected after takeover
cases.details: Worker A holding fence 1 attempts to complete after worker B has taken over with fence 2; worker A completeJob returns false and row remains in sending state; worker B completes with fence 2 successfully.

cases.name: 5. exponential backoff and dead-letter transition
cases.details: Failures back off exponentially (1000ms, 2000ms); the attempt reaching maxAttempts (3) transitions to state='failed' (dead letter) with payload sealed to NULL.

cases.name: 6. operator dead-letter listing and retry
cases.details: Operator listDeadLetters returns failed jobs sorted newest-first; retryDeadLetter resets state to 'queued' and attempts to 0; worker reclaims and completes to 'sent'.

verification.summary: Durable job and outbox primitives verified on real PostgreSQL 16: typed and versioned payloads, business idempotency keys, claim and fence metadata with stale worker rejection, exponential backoff, dead-letter state, and operator inspection/retry tools across 6 dedicated tests.
